# THE NOTICE BOARD [italic]Pinned up by the co-op counter. Read it before you ask.[/italic]
## COUNTER HOURS - [bold]Shift days[/bold]: from the end of first shift to the start of curfew. - [bold]Rest days[/bold]: midday to the evening meal. - [bold]Harvest week[/bold]: closed. Everyone is in the bay. - [bold]Freighter days[/bold]: open late for shipping orders.
## THIS SEASON'S PRICE, AS VOTED - Cured leaf bought from members: $1.10 the pouch weight, up ten cents on last season. - Store prices unchanged. The vote was close.
## RULES OF THE COUNTER - [bold]Adults only.[/bold] The co-op checks colony ID. No exceptions, not even for your father. - [bold]No smoking in the hydroponics bay.[/bold] Ever. The bay has oxygen lines. The bay also has our leaf. - [bold]No smoking near the processor intake.[/bold] The processor staff have asked very nicely. Then less nicely. - [bold]No credit[/bold], except for members, and only until payday. - [bold]Garrison personnel[/bold] are welcome. Please leave your rifle outside. The counter is small and the rifle is long.
## NOTICES - [bold]Lost.[/bold] One briar pipe, carved, with a crack in the bowl. Answers to nothing. Return to Yuki on Solaris Ridge. - [bold]Wanted.[/bold] Empty seed jars, clean. Bring them to the counter. - [bold]Reminder.[/bold] A tenth of every sale goes to the colony clinic. If you smoke, please also visit the clinic. The co-op has paid for it. - [bold]Notice from the administration of {colony}.[/bold] Co-op goods may be bought on this colony at the canteen counter. Smoking is permitted only in marked areas.
